title: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search for Algebraic T-Count Optimization
summary: T-count minimization is an NP-hard problem that arises in fault-tolerant quantum compilation. In the parity-matrix representation, which captures the non-Clifford part of a quantum circuit, algebraic optimizers such as TODD can achieve state-of-the-art results. However, heuristics fixed in advance determine which transformation is applied, limiting the exploration of alternative trajectories that may lead to better solutions.
